query:
select count(*)::text || '-' ||
                  coalesce(md5(string_agg(g.id::text || g.updated_at::text || coalesce(g.category_id::text, '')
                                          || coalesce(c.name, '') || coalesce(c.color, ''),
                                          ',' order by g.id)), '')
                  as "version!"
           from guest_list g left join ticket_categories c on c.id = g.category_id
           where g.event_id = $1
